title: notebook store/1
description: The evidence notebook as the browser keeps it (one localStorage key): its schema number and the entries in order. js/notebook/store.js load() is the authority and checks the schema number only (a record from a newer version is kept and not overwritten, in words: `from-a-newer-version`), a value that is not JSON is `unreadable`, and an entry is checked when it is revived (notebook entry snapshot/1). The entries are open objects here for that reason. The store writes at most 60 entries and refuses a write past that (and an entry past its own size) before it touches what is kept, so the notebook on disk is never half-written; a reader of a larger one, which only another tool could make, still reads what is there. FORMATS.md lists it.
